protocol_amendment_before_any_training: Original audit and all data roles remain immutable. Two ambiguous TRAIN units are withheld from P1, not merged or reassigned.
Training quantiles are recomputed only on the retained TRAIN inputs.
Corrected crowding minimizes the normalized pair distance, as specified in the original MVA plan.
Rotated/size-varying images remain suitable for segmentation; temporal area analysis must separately assess stable ROI.
No locked-role model accuracy or sampling effects were inspected.
limitations: Cultivation identity is supported by dataset structure and filenames, not independently measured biological identity.
Temporal physical scale calibration remains unverified; area results are conditional pixel-view analyses.
External KOMATSUNA validation is not yet performed.
